object.attr: derived: failure analysis CF-G49 (D-G23). Text from another clone or another person's commit reaches widgets that guess rich text, where markup can spoof text, freeze layout or make Windows open a network path. MELLON-CHECK-SRS-84 says the same for validation results.
object.description: The GUI shall show text read from the repository or from git history as plain text in each label, tooltip, grid cell, message, banner and window title.
